Storefront and customer routes of the gift cards module. Send `Accept-Language` (or `X-Locale` from a browser) on every call; a customer route needs the session cookie.

## GET /v1/gift-cards/balance

Check gift card balance

Parameters:

- `code` in query (string, pattern `/^\S{1,32}$/`, required).

Responses:

- `200`: Balance retrieved.
- `400`: Invalid gift card.
